# visionary_alert_rule (Resource)

An alert rule: a threshold on a metric, an anomaly on one, or an SLO burn rate. The metric ids are listed in Alerts → New rule and by GET /api/alerts/meta.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# p95 latency of the checkout route over 800 ms for 2 minutes.
resource "visionary_alert_rule" "slow_checkout" {
  name      = "Slow checkout"
  severity  = "critical"
  metric    = "latency_p95"
  op        = ">"
  threshold = 800
  window    = "5m"
  for       = "2m"
  channels  = [visionary_alert_channel.ops.id]
  runbook   = "https://wiki.example.com/runbooks/checkout"
  labels    = { team = "payments" }

  scope = {
    route = "/checkout"
  }

  # Nobody acknowledged it in 15 minutes: page.
  escalation = [{
    after    = "15m"
    channels = [visionary_alert_channel.pager.id]
  }]
}

# Traffic far from its usual level, in either direction.
resource "visionary_alert_rule" "traffic" {
  name        = "Unusual traffic"
  kind        = "anomaly"
  metric      = "requests_per_min"
  sensitivity = "medium"
  direction   = "both"
  channels    = [visionary_alert_channel.ops.id]
}

# The SLO burning its error budget too fast.
resource "visionary_alert_rule" "slo" {
  name     = "Checkout SLO"
  kind     = "slo"
  target   = 99.5
  channels = [visionary_alert_channel.ops.id]
}

# A PromQL expression.
resource "visionary_alert_rule" "queue" {
  name      = "Queue backing up"
  metric    = "promql"
  promql    = "sum(queue_depth)"
  op        = ">"
  threshold = 1000
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `channels` (List of String) Ids of the channels notified.
- `clear_for` (String) How long the condition must stay clear before resolving.
- `clear_threshold` (Number) Value a reading must pass to count as clear (threshold rules).
- `depends_on_rules` (List of String) Ids of rules that hold this one's notifications back while they fire.
- `direction` (String) Anomaly direction: up, down or both.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is evaluated. Default true.
- `escalation` (Attributes List) Steps that notify more channels when nobody acknowledges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--escalation))
- `for` (String) How long the condition must hold before firing, such as 2m.
- `kind` (String) threshold (default), anomaly or slo.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels, for silences and routing.
- `mention` (String) Starts every message, such as <!here> or @oncall.
- `message` (String) Message body template.
- `metric` (String) Metric id, such as latency_p95, error_rate, log_matches, custom (with sql), custom_metric (with metric_query) or promql (with promql). SLO rules have none.
- `metric_query` (Attributes) The custom metric watched (metric custom_metric). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_query))
- `no_data` (String) A window without data counts as ok (default), alerting or keep.
- `notify_resolved` (Boolean) Notify when resolved. Default true.
- `op` (String) Condition: >, <, >= or <= (threshold rules).
- `promql` (String) PromQL expression (metric promql).
- `query` (String) Log search (metrics log_matches and log_absent).
- `repeat` (String) Re-send a firing alert this often (5m to 7d).
- `runbook` (String) A note or link shown with the alert.
- `scope` (Attributes) What the rule looks at; empty means everything. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope))
- `sensitivity` (String) Anomaly sensitivity: low, medium (default) or high.
- `severity` (String) info, warning (default) or critical.
- `sql` (String) Read-only SQL returning one number (metric custom).
- `target` (Number) SLO target percent (default: Settings → Thresholds).
- `threshold` (Number) Threshold (threshold rules).
- `title` (String) Message title template.
- `window` (String) Evaluation window, such as 5m (default 5m; 15m for anomaly rules).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id Visionary gave it.

<a id="nestedatt--escalation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `escalation`

Required:

- `after` (String) Wait, such as 15m.
- `channels` (List of String) Channel ids.


<a id="nestedatt--metric_query"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_query`

Required:

- `name` (String) Metric name.

Optional:

- `agg` (String) sum, avg, max, min, rate, count, p50, p95 or p99.
- `group` (String) Label to alert on separately for each value.
- `labels` (Map of String) Label filters.


<a id="nestedatt--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope`

Optional:

- `app` (String) Client app.
- `check` (String) Uptime check id, for uptime metrics.
- `container` (String) Container name.
- `event_kind` (String) Security finding kind.
- `event_severity` (String) Lowest security finding severity.
- `host` (String) Host name.
- `instance` (String) Instance name.
- `method` (String) HTTP method.
- `route` (String) Route pattern, such as /orders/{id}.
- `service` (String) Service name.
- `source` (String) Security finding source: api or host.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is the number Visionary shows, for example in the API.
terraform import visionary_alert_rule.example 12
```
